cases.utterance: Set up the bedroom so the light drops to 20% when it gets dark, both blinds close after sunset, and they open again in the morning.
Set up the bathroom so the fan starts when humidity goes above 70%, the light only comes on at 30% when it is dark, and both blinds go down when sunshine is strong.
Configure the living room for summer: if the outside temperature is above 26 and sunshine is high, close both blinds and start the AC, then reopen the blinds when it cools down again.
Set up the kitchen so the light comes on when it gets dark, both blinds go up in strong wind, and they only go down after five minutes of strong sunshine if there is no wind.

Set up the hallway so motion in the dark brings the light to 35%, the front door contact also triggers the light for 90 seconds, and both blinds close when it gets dark and reopen when it gets bright again.

Configure the garden so motion after dark switches on the garden light, irrigation runs automatically when soil moisture is below 20% and it is not raining, and the manual watering switch still works.

Set up the garage so the light stays on for five minutes when the garage door sensor trips, Schalter 2 switches the garage door opener on and off, and at night that same sensor should also bring the light on immediately.
Mach im Schlafzimmer bitte Folgendes: bei CO2 über 1000 sollen beide Jalousien hochfahren, nachts das Licht nur auf 15%, und bei viel Sonne tagsüber die Jalousien wieder runter.

Configure the living room for winter evenings: if the outside temperature falls below 5, open both blinds during daylight, close them again when it gets dark, and start the living room climate control when it drops below 2.
Set up the bathroom so Schalter 1 turns fan boost on if it is off and off if it is on, humidity above 75 starts the fan automatically, and the light stays at 25% whenever it is dark.
Configure the kitchen so Schalter 1 forces both blinds up, strong sunshine lowers them after ten minutes if it is not windy, and darkness turns the light on for two minutes.
Richte den Flur so ein: Wenn die Haustür aufgeht, Licht auf 40 Prozent für zwei Minuten, bei Bewegung im Dunkeln ebenfalls, und die Jalousien sollen bei Sturm rauf fahren.
Set up the garden so manual irrigation only works when it is sunny and not raining, irrigation also starts automatically below 18% soil moisture, and motion after dark turns on the garden light.
Set up the living room so strong sun and heat close both blinds, the AC only starts after five minutes of that condition, and Schalter 1 reopens the blinds as an override.
Configure the bathroom so both blinds close when it gets dark, reopen when brightness returns, the fan starts at 68% humidity, and the light sits at 20% in dark conditions.
30 minutes before the alarm, slowly bring the bedroom light from 0% to 50% for a gentle wake-up
When there's enough natural light in the living room, automatically reduce the artificial lights to save energy
